promoters.name: Acting Through The Ministry Of Coal

business.text: We are one of the largest coal producers in India in terms of production in Fiscal 2026, with production of 176.29 million tonnes of coal, accounting for 16.94% of India’s total coal production in Fiscal 2026.  Our Company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited (“CIL”), is headquartered in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, and was conferred with Miniratna Category - I status on March 15, 2007 and in 2025, completed 40 years of coal mining operations.

business_summary: South Eastern Coalfields is one of the largest coal producers in India in terms of production in Fiscal 2026.

emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – South Eastern Coalfields Limited
emails.text:
Dear Shivani Pujari and Raghavendra Bhat,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of South Eastern Coalfields Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated November 1, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON SOUTH EASTERN COALFIELDS
South Eastern Coalfields is one of the largest coal producers in India in terms of production in Fiscal 2026. We have studied the DRHP closely and the business fits well with our investment focus.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO round: Should the Company consider a pre-IPO placement ahead of the RHP, we would be keen to participate.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of South Eastern Coalfields (the promoters) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
